svg.title: macOS · Gallery · timeline mode, no selection · 1280×800
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GalleryView.swift (macOS branch, timelineMode true and selectedID nil) + App/GallerySidebar.swift + App/GalleryGridContent.swift (TimelineGalleryGrid, TimelineDayHeader, MonthScrubberRail) + App/GalleryTile.swift, as shipped in 394e48e (2026-09-07). Sibling of gallery.svg, which draws grid mode with all three panes; this file carries the two states that one cannot: TIMELINE MODE and NO SELECTION. Drawn at 1280×800 for the same reason gallery.svg is — galleryHeader's intrinsic width is about 691pt and the 760×680 default window cannot render it once the sidebar is showing; the arithmetic is in gallery.svg's desc. NO SELECTION: GalleryPreviewPanel and its Divider are conditional on selectedID resolving to a capture, so with nothing selected the centre column takes the whole 1079pt right of the sidebar and the header's two Spacers open to 185pt each, pushing the title left of centre and the search/sort/zoom/Timeline cluster to the trailing edge — that drift is real, not a drawing artefact, because the title sits between two Spacers rather than in a centred overlay. TIMELINE MODE: GalleryGridContent swaps standardGrid for TimelineGalleryGrid, an HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 0) of a ScrollView and a fixed 56pt MonthScrubberRail — so the rail lives INSIDE the centre column, not at the window edge, and the preview panel would sit outboard of it. The scroll side keeps .padding(.horizontal, 14) and .padding(.top, 14) and lays out a LazyVStack(spacing: 20, pinnedViews: .sectionHeaders) of one Section per calendar day, newest first (groups sorts startOfDay descending, and each day's captures descending inside it). COLUMN COUNT IS FIXED AT 5 HERE and ignores both the header's zoom slider and the gallery.columnCount AppStorage the standard grid reads — the Array(repeating:count: 5) is hard-coded — so the slider is drawn live but changes nothing while Timeline is on, and the tiles are 191×143.25 at spacing 10 rather than the 242×181.5 grid mode gives at the same window size. Column origins 235 / 436 / 637 / 838 / 1039. TimelineDayHeader is 32pt tall (13pt semibold locale-formatted date via .dateTime.weekday(.wide).month().day().year(), then a count in a primary@7% capsule at 12pt medium), carries an opaque LL.screenBackground so pinned headers do not show rows through them, and is inset .padding(.horizontal, 2) from the grid's own padding. Section rhythm as drawn, the 20pt LazyVStack spacing falling between a header and its own grid as well as between Sections: header 115–147, grid 167–310.25; header 330.25–362.25, grid 382.25–525.5; header 545.5–577.5, grid 597.5–740.75; and a fourth header at 760.75 sliding under the floating bar. MONTH SCRUBBER (x 1244–1300): one button per unique month present, in the same newest-first order, 11pt regular secondary abbreviations at .padding(.vertical, 5); January additionally carries its year above it at 9pt semibold and renders its own abbreviation bold and primary, which is the only thing marking a year boundary — there is no divider and no sticky year. Tapping one calls scrollProxy.scrollTo(day, anchor: .top) on the FIRST day of that month, animated. The rail has no scroll indicator and no current-position highlight, so it says where you can go but never where you are. SIDEBAR: drawn with a tag selected — "Sky & weather" filled LL.accent in dot and label — which is the state gallery.svg does not carry, and which raises the "Clear tags" link (12pt medium accent) under the tag rows. Tag selection is a Set and multi-select; the rows are derived from allCaptures.presentSceneTags, i.e. the library AFTER the kind filter but BEFORE the search text, in SceneMetadata.orderedTaxonomy order so the list never reshuffles as projects are analysed. THE ZOOM SLIDER IS NEVER .tint()ed, so its filled track is system blue — the one accent-coloured control on the screen that is not LL.accent. BOTTOM CLEARANCE IS DOUBLE-COUNTED, drawn as shipped: ContentView's .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) already reserves 58pt for the floating bar and the timeline ScrollView appends its own Color.clear.frame(height: 82) — and the month rail, being a second ScrollView in the same HStack, gets the inset but has no 82pt spacer of its own, so the two columns stop at different heights. STATES NOT DRAWN (desc-only): timeline mode WITH a selection, where the preview panel takes 300pt and the scroll side drops to 723pt, putting the five fixed columns at 131pt each; a single day holding more than five captures, which wraps to a second 10pt-spaced row inside the same Section; the empty state, which replaces the whole timeline (GalleryGridContent tests captures.isEmpty before timelineMode, so filtering everything out returns the same "No projects" panel both modes share); sidebar collapsed; the pinned-header overlap at the moment one header slides under the next. HOOKS: LL_TAB=gallery brings the tab front; timeline mode, sidebar state and tag selection have no hooks — gallery.timelineMode and gallery.showSidebar are @AppStorage and are set by seeding defaults before launch, and the tag selection is ephemeral @State that only a click can set. NOT YET VERIFIED against the running Mac app: authored from the source in 394e48e on 2026-09-07, measured off the Swift layout rather than a screenshot. A Release Mac app was running and holds library.json, which has no serialised writer, so a second instance could not be launched safely. SIDEBAR, 2026-09-11: a fourth section, SHAPES (Ellipse · Rectangle · Square · No Shapes), sits under COLLECTIONS — GallerySidebar.shapesSection over AppModel.shapeSummaries, one row per ShapeFilter; drawn at rest here (no row lit). **2026-09-15 — the SYNC PILL** to the right of Timeline (see gallery.svg's note): drawn RED here, sharing off, at 1252–1284; the cluster and the title moved 42 and 21pt left. A deliberate pull on the timeline's scroll side (not the month rail) is "Check PicPlace now" on touch devices; the Mac has no pull. ======== 2026-11-06 ======== SIDEBAR, 2026-11-06: an APPROVED section sits between LIBRARY and what follows (GallerySidebar.approvedSection — one row, the seal, the count of approved outputs; a switch), so every section under it is 90 pt lower. Its count reads 4 here: the approved outputs the lit tag leaves. TILES: a timeline tile is a GalleryTile, so it wears ApprovedSeal top-leading, 6 in, when its project holds an approval — a1, a3, b3 and c3 here. No pane: nothing is selected.
svg.text: macOS · Gallery · timeline mode, no selection · 1280×800 pt window
mirrors App/GalleryGridContent.swift (TimelineGalleryGrid · TimelineDayHeader · MonthScrubberRail) — five columns are hard-coded, so the zoom slider is inert here
